summary: Duke Energy Progress, LLC filed a Form 8-K on September 11, 2026, reporting the consummation of an underwritten debt offering. On September 8, 2026, the company agreed to sell $700 million of First Mortgage Bonds at 5.55% due 2036 and $300 million at 6.15% due 2056, totaling $1 billion, at discounts to par to underwriters led by BNY Mellon, MUFG, PNC, Scotia, SMBC Nikko and U.S. Bancorp. Proceeds are general corporate purposes. This is a routine debt capital markets takedown under an existing shelf, not a special situation.
